name: Calgary
housing: Calgary renters live in downtown and Beltline apartment towers, condos rented from owners, and basement suites and houses in the suburbs.

localRules.text: In Alberta the landlord must do a move-in inspection report with the tenant; without one the landlord cannot keep any of the security deposit for damage.

tenantHelp.name: Residential Tenancy Dispute Resolution Service (RTDRS)
tenantHelp.what: Alberta's tribunal for landlord and tenant disputes, including deposits

tenantHelp.name: Alberta residential tenancies legal resources
tenantHelp.what: list of free legal help for renters in Alberta

climate: Test the furnace and check windows for drafts; winters are cold, and chinooks bring sudden thaws that can expose roof leaks.
fact: Calgary's chinook winds can raise winter temperatures sharply within hours.
